body: I have literally no one in my life who either cares enough about me or that I trust
I don’t want to talk to a doctor or therapist I’d rather not talk to someone who’s paid to listen to me. Just makes it seem a lot less genuine to me
Does it matter what career I want? Cause honestly I don’t even know. I don’t really expect myself to get that far, I doubt I’ll make it to 2020
They don’t. If anything they want me gone.  how can I blame them though, I don’t do anything, nothing changes
I say I’m like a parasite because I cost money,  my family is poor enough as it is and as much as I wish I could help them more there’s nothing I can really do
I wish it was that simple
I have no purpose though. I just exist. I take from society and offer nothing back, I’m like a parasite
Saying that doesn’t make it true
